title: Semisimple algebraic groups over real closed fields
summary: We give a self-contained introduction to linear algebraic and semialgebraic groups over real closed fields, and we generalize several key results about semisimple Lie groups to algebraic and semialgebraic groups over real closed fields. We prove that a torus in a semisimple algebraic group is maximal $\mathbb{R}$-split if and only if it is maximal $\mathbb{F}$-split for real closed fields $\mathbb{F}$.
